The use of web.archive.org as a proxy to obscure the true source (gitflic.ru) was correctly flagged by both models as suspicious obfuscation
Models correctly distinguished between legitimate install hook functions (post_install/post_upgrade) and top-level code that executes when the file is sourced
Consider adding automatic detection for bash <(curl...) and curl|bash patterns as a pre-filter before LLM review, since these are unambiguous attack signatures
